notes:
User is a writer/content creator and freelancer growing their Instagram presence. They recently reached 600 followers and want to maintain momentum, increase likes, comments, participation, and engagement.

Content interests and strategy:
- Share authentic, personal behind-the-scenes content about writing, freelancing, and the creative process.
- Feature their cat, Luna; followers respond especially well to her photos. Ideas include “Luna’s Office Adventures” or “Luna’s Writing Companion.”
- Use Instagram Stories for manuscript snippets, research notes, brainstorming, outlines, workspaces, inspiration boards, and other personal details.
- Encourage UGC through branded hashtags, contests/challenges, clear participation prompts, incentives, regular featuring, and direct engagement with participants.
- Use Polls and Question stickers to learn audience preferences and invite replies.
- Manuscript content should follow a reasonably consistent 2–3-post-per-week rhythm, adjusted as sections are completed, rather than being completely random. Possible recurring labels include “Manuscript Monday,” “Writing Wednesday,” or “Friday Fiction.”
- Ask followers about preferred content and timing, then adapt based on responses.

Earlier content poll:
- Planned Story Poll options:
  1. More writing tips and advice
  2. More behind-the-scenes content
  3. More sneak peeks of the manuscript
- Also invite additional opinions in comments.
- Follow up with an attractive results graphic, thank participants, explain what was learned, highlight the winning preference, and tease related upcoming content.

Current Q&A plan:
- First Q&A will use Instagram Stories’ Question Sticker.
- Theme: the user’s writing process and experiences as a freelancer; they are open to other questions too.
- Announce and promote the session in advance, use a clear call to action, and create a branded hashtag such as #QandAwith[YourName].
- They will answer a manageable selection rather than every question, combine repeated questions by addressing common themes, provide useful additional resources, and may save unanswered items for a future Q&A or post.
- Set expectations transparently in advance by saying they will answer as many questions as possible, not necessarily every one.
- Prioritize concise, engaging answers, authenticity, and making followers feel heard.
- After the Q&A, thank participants and consider sharing answers, common themes, takeaways, or selected questions in a follow-up Story/feed post.

Draft reminder Story the user plans to post:
“Hey everyone! 🙋‍♀️ Just a quick reminder that I'll be hosting a Q&A session in my Instagram Story tomorrow! 🤔 Ask me anything about my writing process, freelancing, or anything else you're curious about. 📝 Use the ‘Question Sticker’ to submit your questions, and I'll do my best to answer as many as I can. 🙏 Thanks for participating, and I'm looking forward to chatting with you all tomorrow! 😊 #QandAwith[YourName] #WritingCommunity #FreelanceLife”

Possible refinement:
- Add an eye-catching visual/GIF and the actual session time if useful.
- Do not invent a time such as “10am EST” unless that is genuinely when the Q&A will occur.
- Replace [YourName] with the user’s actual name/handle if using a personalized branded hashtag.

Tone/preferences:
- User values authenticity, transparency, audience participation, useful resources, and community-building.
- They view interaction and feedback as both engagement tools and sources of inspiration for their writing and content.
